$extensions.aesthetic: dark-native fintech with restrained violet energy

surface.$description: Primary background — Shark dark. The app's native canvas. Never pure black.

surface-subtle.$description: Elevated card surface — one step lighter than Shark for layered hierarchy

surface-raised.$description: Raised containers, modal backgrounds, input fields on dark

surface-overlay.$description: Overlay surfaces — dropdown menus, tooltips, popovers

surface-input.$description: Text input backgrounds — distinct from card surface for affordance

accent.$description: Cornflower Blue — Revolut's signature violet-blue. Primary CTAs, active states, links.

accent-hover.$description: Lighter cornflower for hover states — maintains readability on dark

accent-muted.$description: Translucent cornflower for selected row backgrounds, badge fills

accent-on-dark.$description: Accent on dark surfaces — same as primary, designed dark-first

text-primary.$description: Primary text — pure white for maximum contrast on Shark surfaces

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text — cool-toned gray for descriptions, metadata, labels

text-tertiary.$description: Tertiary text — timestamps, disabled labels, footnotes

text-on-accent.$description: Text on cornflower accent buttons — white for contrast

text-balance.$description: Account balance display — maximum weight and contrast

text-currency.$description: Currency codes and symbols — secondary weight in financial displays

success.$description: Positive financial change — green for gains, completed transfers, verified status

success-text.$description: Success text on dark backgrounds — same green, no darkening needed

success-bg.$description: Success badge background — translucent green on dark

error.$description: Negative financial change — red-pink for losses, failed transactions, alerts

error-text.$description: Error text on dark — same coral-red

error-bg.$description: Error badge background — translucent red on dark

warning.$description: Warning state — amber for pending transactions, security alerts

warning-bg.$description: Warning badge background — translucent amber on dark

border.$description: Default border — subtle white-alpha separation on dark surfaces

border-prominent.$description: Emphasized borders — card outlines, section dividers

border-transaction.$description: Transaction list item separators — nearly invisible hairlines

shadow-dark.$description: Primary shadow on dark — heavy opacity needed for visibility

shadow-ambient.$description: Ambient shadow — soft lift for cards on dark backgrounds

gradient-card-premium.$description: Premium card surface gradient — subtle depth for Metal/Premium tiers

gradient-accent.$description: Accent gradient for featured CTAs and promotional elements

font-primary.$description: Aeonik Pro by CoType Foundry — Revolut's custom geometric sans-serif. Used across all communications.

font-mono.$description: Monospace for IBAN numbers, card numbers, reference codes

scale-balance.$description: Account balance — the largest number on screen

scale-micro.$description: Badge text, currency codes, fine print

scale-tabular.$description: Financial amounts in lists — uses tabular numerals

weight-bold.$description: Balance display — maximum emphasis for the primary number

line-height-tight.$description: Balance display, large numbers — compact vertical

opentype-tabular.$description: Tabular numerals for financial data — ensures column alignment in transaction lists

4.$description: Tight padding — badges, compact pill interiors

6.$description: Dense step — small button vertical padding

8.$description: Base unit — standard gap, list item padding

12.$description: Comfortable gap — card internal padding, button horizontal

16.$description: Standard padding — card body, section internal spacing

20.$description: Mobile page margin, generous card padding

32.$description: Section internal spacing, large card padding

unit.$description: Base grid unit — all spacing derives from 4/8px grid

page-margin-mobile.$description: Mobile horizontal page margin — tighter than most brands

transaction-row-height.$description: Standard transaction list row height — 44px touch target + padding

card-number-gap.$description: Gap between card number groups (4-digit clusters)

radius-xs.$description: Badges, pills, small tags — minimal rounding

radius-sm.$description: Buttons, inputs, small cards — the workhorse radius

radius-lg.$description: Feature cards, account summary panels, modal dialogs

radius-xl.$description: Hero elements, virtual card display, bottom sheets

radius-pill.$description: Pill buttons, category chips, status badges

radius-card-physical.$description: Physical card representation — matches real card corner ratio

width-default.$description: Standard border width for separators and containers

level-0.$description: Flat — no shadow. Most elements on dark surfaces rely on background color shifts, not shadows.

level-1.$description: Subtle lift — cards on dark. Must be heavy enough to register against Shark background.

level-2.$description: Elevated — dropdowns, popovers, bottom sheets. Dual-layer for depth.

level-3.$description: Modal — dialog overlays, expanded card detail views

card-glow.$description: Accent glow — premium card highlight, selected account indicator

duration-instant.$description: Instant feedback — button press, toggle snap

duration-fast.$description: Quick transitions — hover states, color changes

duration-normal.$description: Standard transitions — card expand, tab switch

duration-slow.$description: Deliberate motion — page transitions, bottom sheet slide

easing-default.$description: Standard ease — smooth deceleration for most interactions

easing-spring.$description: Spring overshoot — card flip, balance counter animation

reduced-duration.$description: Near-zero duration for prefers-reduced-motion. Applied via media query.

reduced-easing.$description: Linear easing for reduced motion -- no spring/bounce.

mobile.$description: Small mobile — compact layouts, single column

mobile-lg.$description: Large mobile — wider cards, 2-column grids for chips

desktop-lg.$description: Large desktop — max-width container, generous margins
